title: Consolidation: Public Administration, Ombudsman & Civic Rights

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can synthesize the roles and interactions of Hungarian institutions protecting citizen rights: Ombudsman, courts, and civil organizations.
I can fluently apply abstract verb case government in administrative contexts (hivatkozik -ra/-re, fellebbez -ellen, eleget tesz -nak/-nek, eltekint -tól/-től, elszámol -val/-vel).
I can formulate formal legal submissions and evaluate the transparency of public administration.
